svg.title: llmctx architecture v5 — Rust
svg.desc: Three-phase architecture in Rust. Phase 0, LLM-originated: an LLM writes a delimited llmctx comment block at the top of a generated file, taught via the llmctx.md skill file; the daemon detects this on save and cuts it straight into ADS, skipping Ollama entirely. Phase 1, automatic: VS Code TypeScript extension detects save, notifies llmctxd Rust daemon via TCP socket, daemon calls Ollama REST via reqwest, writes ADS via windows-rs, used only when no comment block is found. Phase 2, manual: user clicks status bar button, extension reads source and ADS directly via Node fs, merges and copies to clipboard.
svg.text: phase 1 · automatic fallback · hand-written files only
LLMs cannot read ADS — always use the status bar button, never upload raw files
git never sees ADS · zero repo bloat · run llmctx index once after cloning
ADS does not survive FAT32 / most zip tools — document this
